206:t_1:260.en:
$$レナード$$
「As you can see, this coat has that capability.」

206:t_1:261.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then I'll use firepower it can't stop...」

206:t_1:262.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's not my only precaution.」

206:t_1:265.en:
$$レナード$$
「Plan 1211, $$アラストル$$. You might call it the world's smallest $$アーム・スレイブ$$.」

206:t_1:266.en:
$$宗介$$
「But if I eliminate you, its master, it's just a useless puppet...!」

206:t_1:267.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Stop, $$宗介$$! He's $$テッサ$$'s brother!」

206:t_1:268.en:
$$宗介$$
「But he's our enemy! The Captain says so too!」

206:t_1:269.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'd like you to calm down a little. I came here to talk.」

206:t_1:270.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$千鳥かなめ$$... Would you mind asking your guard dog there to show a little patience?」

206:t_1:271.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll show you right now whether I'm just a guard dog.」

206:t_1:273.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm not asking you to lower your gun. I only want you to listen.」

206:t_1:275.en:
$$レナード$$
「My request is simple. $$千鳥かなめ$$, would you leave your current life behind and come with me?」

206:t_1:277.en:
$$レナード$$
「I promise a comfortable, free life. We have facilities to satisfy your intellectual curiosity, and above all, complete freedom.」

206:t_1:278.en:
$$レナード$$
「Of course, I won't let the $$新地球皇国$$ interfere either.」

206:t_1:279.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't understand what you're saying. Are you mocking me?」

206:t_1:280.en:
$$レナード$$
「All right. Then I'll explain in more detail.」

206:t_1:281.en:
$$レナード$$
「My organization is starting to get serious.」

206:t_1:283.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$ミスリル$$ and $c tried too hard. And that effort was a mistake.」

206:t_1:284.en:
$$レナード$$
「Until now, the organization paid you little attention, but changing circumstances have forced us to adjust our strategy somewhat.」

206:t_1:285.en:
$$レナード$$
「As part of that, we've decided to eliminate the greatest nuisance, as an example to others.」

206:t_1:287.en:
$$レナード$$
「You seem to understand. That submarine and the white AS with a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$... ARX-7, was it?」

206:t_1:288.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't need to answer that.」

206:t_1:289.en:
$$レナード$$
「...What a shame. It seems we can't be friends.」

206:t_1:290.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you intend to keep talking nonsense, this conversation is over.」

206:t_1:291.en:
$$レナード$$
「All right. Anyway, that's the situation. I'd have liked you to bow out under ideal circumstances, but...」

206:t_1:292.en:
$$レナード$$
「But we're past the point where we can talk about removing or controlling you.」

206:t_1:293.en:
$$レナード$$
「The conclusion is simple. ...Crush the enemy. And take '$$ヨブ$$'.」

206:t_1:295.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's her code name. Don't worry about it.」

206:t_1:296.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So you're saying you'll crush $$テッサ$$ and $$宗介$$, and kidnap me?」

206:t_1:297.en:
$$レナード$$
「The organization has already decided to secure you, even if it takes rough methods.」

206:t_1:298.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Is that enough explanation of why I came all this way to collect you?」

206:t_1:299.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So you came to persuade me beforehand...?」

206:t_1:300.en:
$$レナード$$
「Yes... Because I like you.」

206:t_1:303.en:
$$宗介$$
「How can you say that so shamelessly...!」

206:t_1:306.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I understand. Thanks for your kindness.」

206:t_1:307.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But I have school, and I like my life as it is.」

206:t_1:308.en:
$$かなめ$$
「And above all, there's no way in hell I'm going with you!」

206:t_1:309.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I've told you again and again, I hate you! Now get out of this school, right now!!」

206:t_1:310.en:
$$レナード$$
「How cold. Are you still angry... about that?」

206:t_1:311.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Didn't you hear me?! Get lost!」

206:t_1:313.en:
$$レナード$$
「Why don't you finally accept it?」

206:t_1:315.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're chosen, already beyond a genius. Yet people only think of manipulating us with slick talk.」

206:t_1:316.en:
$$レナード$$
「Do you want them ordering you around?」

206:t_1:318.en:
$$レナード$$
「You must have realized by now. Everyone around you is hopelessly dull and stupid.」

206:t_1:319.en:
$$レナード$$
「Their slow wits actually irritate you, don't they?」

206:t_1:321.en:
$$レナード$$
「...I will. I've warned you.」

206:t_1:322.en:
$$レナード$$
「Whatever happens from now on, I'd rather you didn't blame me.」

206:t_1:327.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$! Take $$千鳥$$ and run, right now!」

206:t_2:3.en:
$$宗介$$
($$アマルガム$$ had already infiltrated the school...)

206:t_2:5.en:
$$宗介$$
(And they've taken $$常磐$$ hostage and are demanding that we hand over $$千鳥$$...)

206:t_2:6.en:
$$宗介$$
(But they say if $c sets foot in $$陣代高校$$, they'll blow up the building with the remaining students inside...)

206:t_2:7.en:
$$宗介$$
(What should I do...? Can I manage this... on my own as I am now...?)

206:t_2:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I know you're in shock. But...」
